summary: AssessmentValidationResult class details various boolean validation properties applicable to an assessment process.
purpose: To determine specific validation results related to assessment conditions, such as interim and final assessment statuses, involvement of instructors and supervisors, and maximum assessment limits.

fields.name: InterimWithoutFinal
fields.description: Indicates whether there is an interim assessment without a final assessment.

fields.name: InstructorsAndSupervisors
fields.description: Indicates the presence of both instructors and supervisors in the assessment process.

fields.name: AssessmentMaximumExceeded
fields.description: Indicates if the assessment maximum limit has been exceeded.

validations: InterimWithoutFinal identifies if an interim assessment exists without being followed by a final assessment.
InstructorsAndSupervisors checks the involvement of both instructors and supervisors.
AssessmentMaximumExceeded checks if the number of assessments has surpassed the allowable limit.
conditions: InterimWithoutFinal is true if interim assessment exists but a final one does not.
InstructorsAndSupervisors becomes true if both categories are involved.
AssessmentMaximumExceeded is true when the assessments exceed the preset limit.
